title: IGV Viewer for VS Code (unofficial)
description: Embed the igv.js genome browser in VS Code. View BAM, CRAM, VCF, bigWig, BED and more next to your code, with a CLI and MCP server for AI agents.

title: TypeMF Runtime
description: Shared TypeMF runtime: one package registry and one instance of every shared model module for all TypeMF extensions.

title: TypeMF Instance Editor
description: A reflective editor for TypeMF model instances (.xmi, .json, .ecore), for generated as well as dynamically loaded metamodels.

title: Freekit — Free AI Coding Agent
description: Connect web AI chats (DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Mistral, Qwen) — or a local Ollama model — to VS Code, with a built-in MCP (Model Context Protocol) client for external tools and a local semantic code index

title: HydraDev — Developer Hydration Companion
description: A friendly hydration companion that reminds you to drink water with an animated desktop avatar.

title: Degauss: Retro Computer Looks
description: Vintage computer looks for VS Code and Windows Terminal: Apple //e green and amber and IBM 3270 ISPF, with period fonts. Windows Terminal also gets IBM PS/2 VGA.
